source.name: Saudi Pro League – Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL
source.note: Official league gallery of the 2026-27 kits. Its 'Al Hazem Away 26-27' montage shows Tameeni's blue print on the shirt chest; the same Tameeni chest print is on the home shirt in match photos from Al-Hazem v Al-Taawoun (2026-09-08; elmoudjazdz Facebook, post 1103011192414808). Tameeni also heads the sponsors' logo list on the club site (alhazem.sa).

source.name: Saudi Pro League – Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL
source.note: The gallery's 'Al Hazem Away 26-27' montage shows a gold 'QAID قايد' print on the sleeve; the same gold shoulder print is on the home shirt in the Al-Hazem v Al-Taawoun match photos (2026-09-08). Qaid is on the sponsors' logo list at alhazem.sa, and qaid.sa carries a 'رعايتنا لدوري روشن' (our Roshn-league sponsorship) section.

source.name: Al-Hazem Club – الحزم يوقّع مع أوفسايد راعيًا رسميًا للأطقم الرياضية في دوري روشن 2026-2027
source.quote: أعلن نادي الحزم السعودي عن توقيع اتفاقية شراكة مع شركة “أوفسايد” لتكون الراعي الرسمي لأطقم الفريق الأول لكرة القدم خلال منافسات دوري روشن السعودي للموسم الرياضي 2026-2027.
source.note: Club announcement: Offside becomes the official kit sponsor (technical supplier) of Al-Hazem's first football team for the 2026-2027 Roshn Saudi League season. Offside's store (offsideksa.com) sells the 'قميص الحزم الأساسي 26/27' (Al-Hazem home shirt 26/27, SKU HZM 10112627-S).

summary: Offside home kit. Tameeni on the front and Qaid on the sleeve (SPL's 2026-27 kit-gallery montage and in-match photos of the home shirt); Offside supplies the kit (club announcement, 2026-07-04). The back of the player-issue shirt has not been confirmed, so the list is not complete.
